title: NoLootOnDrop
description: NoLootOnDrop is a simple but effective plugin that prevents item drops from explosions and automatically despawns player-dropped or block break drops after 10 seconds. Great for reducing lag, preventing loot abuse, and keeping your world clean during PvP,
body:
# NoLootOnDrop v1.0 – Initial Release

• 💥 Prevents block drops from explosions (TNT, beds, crystals, etc.).

• 🪓 Blocks broken by players drop items normally, but despawn after 10 seconds.

• 🎒 Items dropped manually by players will also despawn after 10 seconds.

• ✅ Useful for reducing lag and preventing loot abuse in PvP or minigames.

To test out the plugin join "euprac.net"
I also sell better plugins here: https://discord.gg/uvAxYxggd9
